summary: An official Guangxi Natural Resources first-party cadastral-map inquiry service was identified and documented, but anonymous access to its public portal could not be established from this environment and no safe parcel ID plus full polygon was retrieved. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Chinese discovery queries are recorded verbatim in city-10524-lingshan.json. The official Guangxi announcement says the online service provides visual cadastral-map queries through Tianditu Guangxi and identifies the public portal.
requestOutcomes: Attempted TLS-verified GET of https://bdc.dnr.gx.gov.cn/index with curl; DNS resolution failed in this environment. The web fetcher also reported the portal inaccessible. The official announcement URL was discovered through search but timed out when opened by the web fetcher. No login, credential, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS-verification bypass was used.
